<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the base peak at m/z 193.110 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1) indicates about 12 carbons. Solving 12 C + H + 2 O = 192.103 Da yields the formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂, which matches the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance and fits the isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
